source: Top 500 South African companies directory import (2026-10-15)
purpose: The national taxonomy and the Maps industry vocabulary are extended only where a whole sector present in the import could not be represented by an existing node or industry. Every addition below is paired with the sector that needed it; nothing here is added speculatively.
notes: FIN-ASSET exists because the taxonomy had no branch for asset management, collective investment schemes or investment holding companies: banks, insurers, lenders and payments were represented, capital managers were not.
MFG-MACH exists because capital equipment (earthmoving, mining, industrial machinery) had no manufacturing branch; the closest existing nodes were metals fabrication and mining equipment rebuild.
TRA-AIR-PAX exists because TRA-AIR covered air cargo and aviation services only, so a passenger airline had no placement.
TRA-SVC-RENT exists because vehicle rental and fleet leasing are neither passenger transport nor freight.
PRO-CORP-AUCT exists because auction, disposal and asset realisation work had no professional services branch.
PRO-CONSULT-BBBEE exists because B-BBEE verification is a regulated South African service industry with no branch.
Every other industry in this import maps onto an existing node and adds no node.

nodes.name: Asset Management, Wealth & Investment
nodes.saContext: South African asset managers, collective investment schemes, wealth and stockbroking platforms, and investment holding companies. Distinct from banking and from insurance underwriting because the business model is managing third-party and proprietary capital rather than taking deposits or underwriting risk. Locally dominated by a small number of large managers plus a long tail of boutique and index managers, with JSE-listed investment holding companies and family offices at the top of the structure.

nodes.name: Asset Management & Collective Investment Schemes
nodes.saContext: Discretionary portfolio management, unit trusts and exchange-traded funds, institutional mandates and multi-manager platforms regulated under the Collective Investment Schemes Control Act.

nodes.name: Investment Holding Companies & Family Offices
nodes.saContext: JSE-listed and private investment holding companies that own portfolios of operating subsidiaries across sectors, plus single-family offices. The economic activity is capital allocation and group oversight, which is why they are held here rather than against the sector of any one subsidiary.

nodes.name: Machinery, Equipment & Capital Goods
nodes.saContext: Manufacture, assembly and supply of capital equipment: earthmoving and mining machinery, industrial machinery, pumps, compressors and power transmission components, together with the aftermarket parts and rebuild economy that keeps them running. Kept separate from metals fabrication and from automotive manufacturing because the product is a machine sold into mining, construction, agriculture and industry rather than a component or a consumer vehicle.

nodes.name: Mining, Construction & Earthmoving Equipment
nodes.saContext: Articulated dump trucks, excavators, loaders, drilling rigs and crushing and screening plant, both locally manufactured and imported for distribution, with dealer service networks across the mining and construction belt.

nodes.name: Industrial Machinery, Pumps, Compressors & Power Transmission
nodes.saContext: Processing plant, conveyors, pumps, valves, compressors, bearings, drives and gearboxes supplied and supported into manufacturing, water, energy and mining operations.

nodes.name: Passenger Airline Operations
nodes.saContext: Scheduled and charter passenger airlines operating domestically and regionally, including franchise and low-cost carrier models. Separate from air cargo and from maintenance and ground services because the operating model is seat capacity, network scheduling and yield management.

nodes.name: Vehicle Rental & Fleet Leasing
nodes.saContext: Short-term car rental, long-term full-maintenance leasing and fleet management contracts for corporate, government and rental customers, including the remarketing of de-fleeted vehicles.

nodes.name: Auctions, Disposals & Asset Realisation
nodes.saContext: Auction houses and asset realisation specialists conducting timed, online and on-site sales in fine art, collectibles, industrial plant, commercial vehicles, livestock and property, together with liquidation and appraisal services.

nodes.name: B-BBEE Verification, Rating & Transformation Advisory
nodes.saContext: SANAS-accredited B-BBEE verification agencies issuing measured-entity certificates against the sector codes and the generic scorecard, together with transformation, ownership-structuring and enterprise and supplier development advisory that prepares measured entities for verification.

pocketMappings.note: Banking, insurance and diversified financial services sit inside the finance macro-sector.
The pocket spans coal, diamonds and mine services, which are separate L2 branches.
Private generation and fuel supply sit in energy; the state utility branches for electricity and water sit in the public sector macro-sector.
Retail and wholesale trade are separate macro-sectors, and this pocket contains both.
Marketing, advertising, media and market research are held in professional and business services in the national tree, not in ICT.
Airline operations sit in transport, defence manufacturing in manufacturing and the state air transport entities in the public sector.
